gemsbok: A gemsbok, a large heavily built antelope with a fawn-grey body, a striking black-and-white facial mask, a black stripe along the flank dividing fawn from white underside, and very long perfectly straight slender horns rising back from the head in a shallow V, standing square on all four legs
bumblebeebat: A Kitti's hog-nosed bat, the smallest bat in the world, a tiny reddish-brown bat with a distinctive broad pig-like snout, small ears, no tail, and delicate translucent wing membranes held partly folded, clinging upright to a vertical surface
electriceel: An electric eel, a long thick cylindrical dark olive-grey fish with a flattened blunt head, small eyes, a pale orange-yellow throat and underside, and a single very long undulating fin running the whole length of its belly, no dorsal fin, body held in a shallow S-curve
giantclam: A giant clam, an enormous thick-shelled bivalve with heavy fluted wavy-edged white shell halves gaping open, and between them a thick fleshy mantle patterned in iridescent electric blue green and gold spots, viewed from above and slightly to one side
egyptianvulture: An Egyptian vulture, a small slender vulture with dirty-white plumage, black flight feathers, a shaggy ruff of pointed white neck feathers, a bare wrinkled bright yellow-orange face, and a slim hooked bill, standing upright on both legs
europeanbadger: A European badger, a stocky low-slung animal with a broad grizzled grey body, short powerful legs, small ears, and a distinctive white head marked with two bold black stripes running from the snout back through each eye to the ears, standing on all four legs
eurasianmagpie: A Eurasian magpie, a sleek crow-relative with a glossy black head breast and back, a crisp white belly and white wing patch, iridescent blue-green sheen on the wings, and a very long graduated tail glossed with green and purple, standing alert on both legs
commontoad: A common toad, a squat broad-bodied amphibian with warty olive-brown dry skin, a wide blunt head, prominent coppery-orange eyes with horizontal pupils, short sturdy limbs, and no smooth moist frog sheen, sitting hunched on all fours
loggerheadturtle: A loggerhead sea turtle, a large marine turtle with a reddish-brown heart-shaped carapace, a notably large blocky head with powerful jaws, yellowish-brown limbs flattened into paddle-like flippers, and a pale yellow underside, swimming with both foreflippers extended
aldabratortoise: An Aldabra giant tortoise, a very large tortoise with a high-domed dark grey-brown carapace, a long thick neck extended upward, a small blunt scaly head, and stout columnar elephantine legs covered in bony scales, standing on all four legs
